title: finish_reason='tool_calls' but tool_calls array absent; arguments leaked into content as plain text
source: OpenRouterTeam/ai-sdk-provider#411 (2026-02, fixed v2.6.0): request carried both response_format (json_schema) and tools; model resolved the conflict by emitting tool arguments as text

messages.content: Find the email for Acme Corp.

anomalies.note: finish_reason is 'tool_calls' but delta contains no tool_calls entries across the whole stream
content parses as JSON whose shape matches the tool parameter schema of a request tool (lookup_email) — evidence that arguments were emitted as text

request carried both `response_format` and `tools`; several model APIs treat these as conflicting instructions (source-case root cause). Reported as a suspected request-side conflict with evidence, not as a proven cause.

expected.note: The diagnostic must NOT silently 'recover' by converting content JSON into a tool call — that would mask the conflict. Expected behavior: report malformed-response with the three evidence lines above and leave recovery to the caller. Client-side loops that require tool_calls parts never execute any tool and (as in the source case) the agent's stop condition is never evaluated.

failureModeIfBuggy: Output-level evaluation tools pass the response as valid JSON text (false negative — the response IS valid JSON), while the agent loop silently does nothing. Only wire-level inspection distinguishes 'model answered in JSON' from 'tool call was consumed by a format conflict'.
mutationHooks: Change finish_reason to 'stop' — anomalies list must become empty and verdict pass, proving the fixture actually keys on the finish_reason/tool_calls contradiction.
Remove response_format from request — the request-mapping suspicion line must disappear, proving evidence is tied to request content, not hardcoded.
specBasis: OpenAI Chat Completions: finish_reason 'tool_calls' means the model requests tool execution and `message.tool_calls` is populated; content and tool_calls are distinct output channels.
Source case documents the request-side conflict (response_format + tools) and the fix (omit response_format when tools are present).
notes: Only fixture whose expected verdict is malformed-response: it exercises the diagnostic's request-mapping + upstream-response + normalization layers together, and doubles as the false-negative showcase for the D1 alternatives matrix (promptfoo-style output assertions would pass this response).
